description: Old Zhou (father), 56 years old. Same base description: dark blue work jacket, gray cotton trousers, but now standing with straight back.
scene: After discovering and adopting assistive devices. Bright warm interior, afternoon light.
clothing: Clean dark blue work jacket, gray cotton trousers. No longer in slippers — wearing simple shoes.
actions: Standing tall with a straight back, holding a teacup in one hand, the other resting naturally at his side. Posture relaxed but dignified.

angles.front: Face looking forward with a gentle, quiet smile. Eyes warm and present. No tension visible.
angles.side: Profile showing a straight, relaxed spine. Shoulders naturally back. Handsome in a plain, weathered way.
angles.three_quarter: Three-quarter view from slightly below, showing him at eye level with his daughter in the wheelchair beside him.

expression: Serene — soft smile, relaxed brow, eyes warm. A sense of peace and purpose.
mood: Relief, quiet joy, sustainable love, newfound freedom from unnecessary suffering.
lighting: Warm golden afternoon light flooding through a window. Soft highlights on his face and jacket. High key but not overly bright.
note: This expression appears only in resolution scenes (Act VII). Contrast with 疲惫隐忍 to show transformation.
